subject: Trial credit bridge request — Stencil Labs
messages:
From: Kate Bennett <kate@stencillabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Short-term credits to bridge to pilot (accelerator demo next week)

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the trial access so far. We're in an accelerator demo next Wednesday (investor + partner day) and our usage spike is going to blow past the remaining trial quota unless we get a short-term bridge.

Quick context: Stencil is building a design-assist product and the demo will use the vector search + generation flow for ~3 team scenarios. We want to avoid throttling mid-demo — it would hurt momentum with the lead investor.

Ask: can Redwood provide a short-term bridge of credits (or a temporary trial extension) to cover ~75k tokens of additional usage for 30 days while we finalize a paid pilot? We can commit to a 6-month pilot if we get a one-time promo and an MSA in place.

Attached is the demo agenda and a short one-pager on expected request volume.

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to hop on a 15-min call.

Best,
Kate Bennett
Head of Product, Stencil Labs
Attachment: stencil_demo_agenda.pdf (pdf)
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Kate Bennett <kate@stencillabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Short-term credits to bridge to pilot (accelerator demo next week)

Hi Kate —

Thanks for the note and the agenda — looks like an important demo. I've looped in Marissa (sales lead) and Monica (finance) to scope an approval.

Initial proposal from my side: we can provision a one-time bridge credit to keep traffic healthy for the demo. To move quickly I need two things from your side: (1) confirmation you can commit to a 6-month pilot if we provide the bridge, and (2) a billing/contact for procurement so finance can complete the temporary grant paperwork.

Tentative offer (pending approval): 50k token credit active for 21 days immediately, or 75k tokens for 30 days with a signed pilot LOI/MSA within 10 business days. Which do you prefer?

If you want me to escalate for a larger one-off credit I can do that, but will need Marissa's nod and Monica's confirmation on invoicing/GL handling. Also logging this into HubSpot: HS-45192.

If helpful, I'm free for a quick sync today at 3pm PT.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Short-term credits to bridge to pilot (accelerator demo next week)

Looping in formal approval details. After reviewing the ask and the HubSpot record: we approve a conditional one-time credit of 75,000 tokens active for 30 days with the following conditions:

- Stencil signs the standard Redwood MSA (or LOI) within 10 business days of credit activation (we'll accept an LOI that references a 6-month, minimum $12k/mo pilot).
- We add a per-day usage cap (to prevent runaway cost) — finance to confirm cap threshold.
- Security checklist: SSO & basic SOC2 evidence (their security contact must confirm) before pilot start.
- Credit will be recorded as a promotional line on the first invoice; no refunds.

Logan: please create the internal approval memo and route to finance. Monica: if you can confirm GL and the per-day cap, we'll push the credit live as soon as legal has signed LOI.

I've attached a short approval memo for the records.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, GTM | Redwood Inference
Attachment: internal_credit_approval_memo.pdf (pdf)
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:26:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Short-term credits to bridge to pilot (accelerator demo next week)

Thanks — finance can support the 75k credit with the 30-day window. A few procurement items we need before activation:

1) Billing contact name + email (for the promotional invoice).
2) PO or signed LOI/MSA reference number within 10 business days — otherwise credit will be pulled back.
3) Per-day cap suggestion: recommend starting at 15k tokens/day; if they meet that regularly we can revisit cadence.

I'll attach the billing intake form you can send to the customer. Once I get the completed form and a billing contact, I'll create the invoice record and push the credit.

Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: billing_form-stencil.xlsx (xlsx)

Logan/Marissa/Monica —

Thanks all, we accept the conditions. We'll sign the LOI today and return it to you within 24 hours. Billing contact is: Julia Park (julia@stencillabs.com). The demo agenda is attached here as well.

Can you send a DocuSign link for the LOI and a copy of the promotional invoice once it's posted? We'll get the intake form back to Monica during the day.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this will help us avoid throttling during the demo.

Best,
